as_told.title: Dr. Ia Whitley trains babies to keep synesthesia for alien communication

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, talks about a woman he calls Dr. Iya Whitley, a space psychologist, who he says is trying to train babies to keep their synesthesia, a blending of the senses such as seeing colours when hearing sounds. In a later episode he adds that the purpose is to help with communicating with aliens. If true, it would mean someone is preparing human minds for contact.
